svg.text: Figure B: Avalanche Validator Lifecycle Model v0.8.0 — Detailed Lifecycle Execution
Internal Execution Architecture of PSUB 0 (p_lifecycle): Stage Coupling, Intermediate Outputs, Common Policy Signal, and Parallel State Updates
Pre-PSUB State & Day Context Initialization (evaluated on pre-transition state X_t)
Day Context & Yield Signal Evaluation: G(S_t ; D_menu, ψ_prot)
Constructs Day(t, start, draw, blocks, renewal_gap, entry_gap, settings). Evaluates yield feedback:
• Renewal Gap: g_t^(R) = offered_rate(d_tenure; S_t, ψ_prot) - D_menu_renewal
• Entry Gap: g_t^(E) = offered_rate(14d; S_t, ψ_prot) - D_menu_entry
Sequential Stage Execution in run_stages(stages, state, day)
Each stage receives (state, day, earlier); earlier dictionary stores preceding stage outputs. Executed sequentially inside p_lifecycle.
P(R=1) = σ(x^T β + ρ_R g_t^(R) + δ_r)
Reads: O_t (eligible: τ >= 8d), no yield response
Participation Candidates N_t = (renews, comes_back, arrivals) pool sequentially into Continuation
Executes both duration selection & stake choice within the single stage
Empirical transition (4 previous bins) for renewals/returns; first_days for arrivals
Part B: Stake Choice s' ∈ [2k, 3M] AVAX (StakeChoice)
Hurdle p_(c,b,q) + 10-band log-ratio quantiles (50-observation fallback threshold)
Reads: started commitments from Continuation, S_t
Reads: state, renewal, returns, started, sched Q_t
Emits: Emits complete terminal policy signal dictionary
COMMON POLICY SIGNAL = terminal output of assembly_stage
State-Update Function Bank: Exactly 24 Functions Evaluated in Parallel on Pre-PSUB State X_t
cadCAD execution semantics: each update function receives (params, substep, history, state=X_t, signal). Parallel evaluation, not sequential mutation.
Keys: stakes, days_left, done, after_return, days, handed_on, returns, node_key
Implementation Logic: s_copy(name) updates each slice from signal. Sets days_left=days for new starts, decrements continuing.
Keys: out_stakes, out_days, out_done, out_last_days, out_returns, out_node_key
Implementation Logic: s_copy(name) updates out-of-set records. Increments out_days for retained nodes; appends new unrenewed exits.
Implementation Logic: s_supply evaluates state["supply_navax"] + signal["issued_navax"]. Strictly reads pre-PSUB supply S_t.
Implementation Logic: s_count (len(stakes)), s_stake (sum(stakes)), s_out (len(out_stakes)), s_nakamoto (decentralization over node_keys).
Keys: issued_navax, yield_gap_pp, started_stake_navax, started_stake_days_navax, offered_rate_30d
Implementation Logic: s_copy(name) passes daily transition flux quantities into simulation record for observable metric export.
• Diamonds (Muted Pink): Stochastic behavioural transition policies. • Pentagons (Sage Green): Deterministic protocol mechanisms & state-update operations (*adapted convention).
• Stage Order: Stages 1–6 execute sequentially inside p_lifecycle; earlier outputs feed subsequent stages. All 24 state updates evaluate in parallel against pre-PSUB state X_t.
